name: Dr. Henry
title: Director & Principal
bio: Dr. Henry is a writer, musician, pastor, missionary, and educator. As the Director and Principal of Glory Education Centre (GEC), he provides leadership in academic excellence, Christian education, and ministry. He is committed to equipping students through quality education, spiritual development, and community service.

name: H. Lunjohnson Misao
title: Academic Dean
qualifications: B.A. (Manipur University), B.D., M.Th. in Christian Ministry (Education)
bio: H. Lunjohnson Misao completed his B.A. from Manipur University, followed by a Bachelor of Divinity and an M.Th. in Christian Ministry (Education) under the Senate of Serampore College. After serving in pastoral ministry, he joined Glory Education Centre as a full-time faculty member and now serves as Academic Dean.

name: Lhiwetshou Tsuhah
title: Teaching Faculty & Students Dean
bio: Lhiwetshou Tsuhah holds an M.Th. in Pastoral Counselling from India Baptist Theological Seminary, Kottayam. He has served as a missionary teacher in South Sikkim, a women's ministry leader, and an assistant in charge at El Shaddai. He currently serves as Teaching Faculty and Students Dean at GEC.

name: Miss Elis
title: Lecturer & Warden
bio: Miss Elis serves as Lecturer and Warden at Glory Education Centre. She is passionate about teaching, discipleship, mentoring students, and providing spiritual guidance while fostering a Christ-centered and disciplined learning environment.

name: Akhilesh Kumar
title: Boys Warden
bio: Akhilesh Kumar serves as the Boys Warden at GEC. He is committed to student care, Christian ministry, leadership, and providing spiritual guidance while pursuing a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.).

name: Bei Ho Valia
title: Lecturer
bio: Bei Ho Valia is a dedicated lecturer committed to academic excellence and Christian ministry. He is passionate about mentoring students and equipping future leaders with sound theological knowledge and strong Christian character.

name: Rev. Samuel
title: Bishop & GEC Faculty
bio: Rev. Samuel serves as a Bishop and faculty member at Glory Education Centre. He is actively involved in pastoral ministry, biblical teaching, mentoring students, and preparing future Christian leaders through faithful service.
specialization: Pastoral Ministry, Biblical Teaching, Christian Leadership

name: Gin Piang
title: Lecturer
bio: Gin Piang accepted Christ during his teenage years and completed his Master of Theology in Missiology. As a preacher, pastor, and lecturer at GEC, he is dedicated to teaching, mentoring students, and equipping believers for Christian ministry.

name: Rev. Nay Lin Aung
title: Lecturer
bio: Rev. Nay Lin Aung serves as Pastor of Khumi Christian Church and Lecturer at Glory Education Centre. He is committed to preaching God's Word, mentoring students, and preparing believers for faithful Christian ministry.

name: Dal Lam Thang
title: Music Teacher
bio: Dal Lam Thang is a dedicated music educator and guitarist with expertise in guitar, piano, choir, and music theory. He is passionate about helping students develop their musical gifts through practical and disciplined learning.

name: Sir Solomon
title: Computer Teacher & Technical Support
bio: Sir Solomon manages the institution's technical infrastructure, including computers, biometric systems, and attendance management. During the Summer Course, he teaches Computer Studies and faithfully supports the technological development of Glory Education Centre.
specialization: Computer Studies, Technical Support, IT Administration

name: Rebecca
title: Accountant
bio: Rebecca serves as the Accountant at Glory Education Centre. She faithfully oversees financial management and administration with integrity and responsibility, supporting the institution's mission of providing quality Christian education.

name: Daniel Ngun Nang
title: Chef & Manager
bio: Daniel Ngun Nang has faithfully served at Glory Education Centre for several years as Chef and Manager. Alongside managing daily operations, he actively participates in youth ministry, encouraging young people to grow in their faith through servant leadership.
